component.name: Vault Launcher
component.summary: Pick an Obsidian vault and open it

description.p: A small window that lists your Obsidian vaults and opens the one you pick, instead of whatever vault Obsidian opened last.

ul.li: Vaults are read from Obsidian's own configuration and kept in sync while the window is open
Add folders by hand, give vaults your own labels, hide the ones you do not need
Sort by last use, folder name or label
Light, dark or system theme matching Obsidian's default look
Optionally closes itself after opening a vault

description.p: Vault Launcher is not affiliated with Obsidian.
